crossRefs.note: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from…
However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

translations.web: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
translations.bsb: As for you, however, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
translations.kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
translations.asv: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
